basic_details.job_title: Territorial Army Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Indian Army - Territorial Army has released the Territorial Army Officer Recruitment 2026 notification through the Army Headquarters Selection Board (ASB) for Ex-Armed Forces Commissioned Officers. A total of 5 Territorial Army Officer vacancies (4 for Male and 1 for Female candidates) have been announced under the Territorial Army Recruitment 2026. The recruitment is exclusively for former commissioned officers of the Army, Navy, and Air Force who wish to serve in a part-time military role while continuing their civilian profession.

application_fee.details: No application fee has been specified in the notification. The application form is available free of cost for download from the official website.

age_limit.details: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 42 years, as on the date of application The upper age limit may be relaxed at the discretion of the Chief of the Army Staff

qualification.details: Note: Serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, and para-military forces are not eligible to apply.
qualification.nationality: Citizen of India (male and female); Gorkha subjects of Nepal and certain persons of Indian origin are also eligible under specified conditions

salary_details.details: Pay and allowances for Territorial Army Officers, when embodied for training or military service, are the same as those admissible to Regular Army Officers of equivalent rank, as per the 7th Central Pay Commission.

selection_process: Screening and interview by the Army Headquarters Selection Board (ASB) at Directorate General Territorial Army
New Delhi Number of candidates called for interview depends on total applications received and vacancies to be filled Recommended candidates undergo Medical Examination at Armed Forces Clinic
New Delhi Final selection is subject to Police Verification
There is no written examination for this recruitment; selection is through interview only.
how_to_apply: Download the Application Form (IAF (TA)-9 Revised, Part-1) from www.indianarmy.nic.in free of cost
Fill the form completely in your own handwriting
Attach a photocopy of the Release Order and Release Medical Board Proceedings

Send the completed application by India Post only to: Directorate General Territorial Army, Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence, 4th Floor, 'A' Block, Ministry of Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi - 110001
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 25 August 2026
important_instructions: Applications sent by any mode other than India Post will not be accepted Incomplete, ineligible, or late applications received after 25 August 2026 will be rejected without intimation Applications from civilian candidates will not be accepted and will be rejected without intimation No request for change of interview date will be entertained Admission to the interview is purely provisional, subject to meeting all eligibility conditions Concealment of information or furnishing false particulars will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage

Candidates looking for more opportunities can also explore the latest Delhi Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to the NCR region can check New Delhi Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Ex-servicemen holding a graduate qualification can also browse more Ex-Servicemen Government Jobs and Defence Recruitment 2026 notifications matching their eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: The Indian Army has released the Territorial Army Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification for Ex-Armed Forces Commissioned Officers through the Army Headquarters Selection Board (ASB) - 2026. A total of 5 vacancies (4 for Male and 1 for Female candidates) have been announced for the Territorial Army Officer (Provincial TA) post. The notification includes complete details regarding eligibility, vacancies, salary, selection process, required documents, and application procedure. Eligible ex-servicemen can submit their offline applications from 27 July 2026 to 25 August 2026 through India Post. Download Official Territorial Army Officer Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies have been announced for Provincial Territorial Army. The organisation has clarified that vacancies are subject to change as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Note: Serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, and para-military forces are not eligible to apply.

rows.details: Only Ex Service Commissioned Officers (Army, Navy, Air Force)
Citizen of India (male and female); Gorkha subjects of Nepal and certain persons of Indian origin are also eligible under specified conditions
18 to 42 years as on date of application
Must be physically and medically fit in all respects (medical category S1H1A1P1E1)
Must be gainfully employed at the time of application

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 42 years, as on the date of application The upper age limit may be relaxed at the discretion of the Chief of the Army Staff

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Officer 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Pay and allowances for Territorial Army Officers, when embodied for training or military service, are the same as those admissible to Regular Army Officers of equivalent rank, as per the 7th Central Pay Commission.

content_sections.heading: Terms and Conditions of Service
content_sections.text: Territorial Army is a part-time commitment with mandatory two months of training every year and does not offer a full-time career Service does not guarantee pension; it is subject to embodied service as per organisational requirement Commission is granted in the rank of Lieutenant, subject to fulfilling TA Rule 20A Promotion up to Lieutenant Colonel is by time scale; promotion to Colonel and Brigadier is by selection Candidates undergo Pre-Commission Training and are commissioned only on its successful completion

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee has been specified in the notification. The application form is available free of cost for download from the official website.

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Officer 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening and interview by the Army Headquarters Selection Board (ASB) at Directorate General Territorial Army, New Delhi Number of candidates called for interview depends on total applications received and vacancies to be filled Recommended candidates undergo Medical Examination at Armed Forces Clinic, New Delhi Final selection is subject to Police Verification There is no written examination for this recruitment; selection is through interview only.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-2, filled in own handwriting All educational qualification certificates (from Matriculation onwards) Latest physical fitness certificate from a registered MBBS doctor Photo identity proof (Voter ID / PAN Card / Aadhaar Card / Passport / Driving Licence) Domicile / residential proof Proof of age (Matriculation / Senior Secondary certificate) Service certificate and No Objection Certificate from current employer (as applicable) Affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (for self-employed candidates) Copy of Release Order and Release Medical Board Proceedings PAN Card and Aadhaar Card copies Copies of certificates of all additional courses completed Discharge / Service Particulars Booklet Copy of latest filed Income Tax Return (ITR)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the Application Form (IAF (TA)-9 Revised, Part-1) from www.indianarmy.nic.in free of cost Fill the form completely in your own handwriting Attach a photocopy of the Release Order and Release Medical Board Proceedings Send the completed application by India Post only to: Directorate General Territorial Army, Integrated Headquarters of Ministry of Defence, 4th Floor, 'A' Block, Ministry of Defence Office Complex, KG Marg, New Delhi - 110001 Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 25 August 2026

content_sections.heading: Territorial Army Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications sent by any mode other than India Post will not be accepted Incomplete, ineligible, or late applications received after 25 August 2026 will be rejected without intimation Applications from civilian candidates will not be accepted and will be rejected without intimation No request for change of interview date will be entertained Admission to the interview is purely provisional, subject to meeting all eligibility conditions Concealment of information or furnishing false particulars will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage Candidates looking for more opportunities can also explore the latest Delhi Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to the NCR region can check New Delhi Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only Ex Armed Forces Commissioned Officers (Army, Navy, or Air Force) who are Indian citizens and meet the age, education, and physical fitness criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Territorial Army ASB 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 25 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for Provincial TA (4 Male, 1 Female), subject to change as per organisational requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Territorial Army Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 42 years of age as on the date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the notification; the application form is free of cost.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Territorial Army Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be downloaded from www.indianarmy.nic.in, filled by hand, and sent only by India Post to the Directorate General Territorial Army, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a Territorial Army Officer?
faq.answer: A Lieutenant in the Territorial Army draws pay at Level 10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) plus Military Service Pay of ₹15,500, same as Regular Army Officers when embodied.
